competency: Recognise and say each expected word accurately while remaining in one-word visual mode.
observable_oral_behavior: The spoken token matches the expected word; substitutions and omissions are rare, and a corrected word is distinguished from a first-pass correct word.
measurement: first_pass_accuracy = first-pass correct expected words / assessable expected words; final_accuracy = correct words after accepted self-corrections / assessable expected words.
p10_success_rule: At P10: final_accuracy ≥97% and first_pass_accuracy ≥95%. Before P10, use the passage-specific target; oral results coach rather than block during Sessions 1–100.
readiness_evidence_rule: Use same-RS valid P10 evidence under the canonical readiness specification.
readiness_status_rule: Use readiness_state only: PRIMARY_PENDING → PRIMARY_PASS/CONFIRMATION_PENDING → CONFIRMED_READY, or cause-specific NOT_YET / DISCORDANT_NOT_YET / REASSESS_TECHNICAL / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE / INVALID_FORM / DIAGNOSTIC_HOLD. Only CONFIRMED_READY initially closes readiness; BASELINE_MASTERY is progress reporting only.
p10_confirmation_policy: CONFIRM-1.0: A single valid P10 pass never closes an RS. Each RS readiness cycle uses two fresh unseen equivalent P10 forms: PRIMARY then CONFIRMATION. No coaching, hints, scored-result disclosure, or targeted practice may occur between a passing PRIMARY and its CONFIRMATION. Both valid forms must satisfy the same RS P10 readiness rule. If PRIMARY fails, stop the cycle and remediate before a new cycle. If PRIMARY passes but CONFIRMATION fails, mark DISCORDANT_NOT_YET and remediate before a new cycle. Technical-invalid forms are REASSESS_TECHNICAL and do not count as valid attempts. All valid forms remain in the audit record; the system may never cherry-pick the best historical pass.
equivalent_form_policy: EQUIV-2.1: exact 100 COUNT-100 words; World 1 one-word display; same RS/P10, scoring version, threshold version/status, comprehension blueprint class and safety/accessibility gates; fresh unseen content; non-compensatory global + RS-specific matching; candidate must pass all tolerances embedded in the canonical v0.22 Markdown specification.
attempt_policy: ATTEMPT-1.0: A readiness cycle is PRIMARY→CONFIRMATION. A valid failure ends that cycle. A new cycle may begin only after an intervening targeted learning block for that RS. After two consecutive failed/discordant valid cycles, set DIAGNOSTIC_HOLD and require at least two targeted non-readiness practice passages plus a documented diagnostic review before another readiness cycle. There is no unlimited back-to-back retry loop. Genuine later learning may reopen assessment after the required learning block.

There is no unlimited back-to-back retry loop. Genuine later learning may reopen assessment after the required learning block.

p10_comprehension_readiness_rule: First-attempt independent mastery = at least 3/4 correct AND the designated primary-skill item correct, before any hint, targeted reread, answer feedback, narrowing, worked example, or remediation. Comprehension readiness requires two independent first-attempt passes on fresh matched forms: COMP_PRIMARY_PASS then COMP_CONFIRMATION_PASS. No targeted comprehension coaching, hinting, answer explanation, or missed-item disclosure occurs between a passing PRIMARY and its CONFIRMATION. Both forms use the same P10 blueprint class but fresh passage evidence and fresh question wording. Only COMPREHENSION_CONFIRMED contributes to Band-A readiness.
readiness_recency_rule: Readiness evidence remains CURRENT until the first of: >56 calendar days since the latest passing same-RS confirmation/revalidation; >16 subsequent valid Band-A assessment/remediation sessions; or >28 consecutive calendar days with no SpeedReader learning session. Material scoring/threshold-version changes invalidate evidence immediately rather than merely making it stale. These numeric limits are PROVISIONAL_PILOT and require later calibration.
revalidation_rule: When evidence is REVALIDATION_DUE only because of recency/inactivity, use one fresh unseen EQUIV-2.1 same-RS P10 revalidation form. Score oral and comprehension streams independently before any targeted feedback. A passing stream renews only that stream's freshness anchor. A valid failing stream becomes NOT_YET and requires targeted remediation followed by a new full PRIMARY→CONFIRMATION cycle for that stream. Technical invalidity does not count as failure and does not reset freshness until valid evidence is obtained.
minimum_evidence_rule: Exactly 10 planned tagged longer-word targets; all 10 must remain assessable for the readiness percentage.
p10_dimension_blueprint: Q1 D2: Sequence | Q2 D8: Vocabulary-in-context | Q3 D3: Cause/effect | Q4 D9: Judgment/application
p10_opportunity_construction_rule: RS05 LONGER-WORD DECODING P10: include exactly 10 writer-tagged 2–4 syllable targets. Distribute them 3/3/4 across the passage thirds in any order; do not cluster. At least 4 targets must be 2-syllable, at least 3 must be 3-syllable, and at least 1 must be 4-syllable; the remaining 2 may be 2–4 syllables. Only 3–4 of the 10 may be deliberate stretch/less-familiar words; the remainder should be familiar or readily decodable longer words.

p10_comprehension_readiness_rule: First-attempt independent mastery = at least 3/4 correct AND the designated primary-skill item correct, before any hint, targeted reread, answer feedback, narrowing, worked example, or remediation. Comprehension readiness requires two independent first-attempt passes on fresh matched forms: COMP_PRIMARY_PASS then COMP_CONFIRMATION_PASS. No targeted comprehension coaching, hinting, answer explanation, or missed-item disclosure occurs between a passing PRIMARY and its CONFIRMATION. Both forms use the same P10 blueprint class but fresh passage evidence and fresh question wording. Only COMPREHENSION_CONFIRMED contributes to Band-A readiness.
readiness_recency_rule: Readiness evidence remains CURRENT until the first of: >56 calendar days since the latest passing same-RS confirmation/revalidation; >16 subsequent valid Band-A assessment/remediation sessions; or >28 consecutive calendar days with no SpeedReader learning session. Material scoring/threshold-version changes invalidate evidence immediately rather than merely making it stale. These numeric limits are PROVISIONAL_PILOT and require later calibration.
revalidation_rule: When evidence is REVALIDATION_DUE only because of recency/inactivity, use one fresh unseen EQUIV-2.1 same-RS P10 revalidation form. Score oral and comprehension streams independently before any targeted feedback. A passing stream renews only that stream's freshness anchor. A valid failing stream becomes NOT_YET and requires targeted remediation followed by a new full PRIMARY→CONFIRMATION cycle for that stream. Technical invalidity does not count as failure and does not reset freshness until valid evidence is obtained.
minimum_evidence_rule: At least 6 assessable terminal-boundary opportunities; form validator rejects a P10 readiness form below 6.
p10_dimension_blueprint: Q1 D8: Vocabulary-in-context | Q2 D1: Direct recall | Q3 D7: Simple inference | Q4 D4: Prediction

readiness_recency_rule: Readiness evidence remains CURRENT until the first of: >56 calendar days since the latest passing same-RS confirmation/revalidation; >16 subsequent valid Band-A assessment/remediation sessions; or >28 consecutive calendar days with no SpeedReader learning session. Material scoring/threshold-version changes invalidate evidence immediately rather than merely making it stale. These numeric limits are PROVISIONAL_PILOT and require later calibration.
revalidation_rule: When evidence is REVALIDATION_DUE only because of recency/inactivity, use one fresh unseen EQUIV-2.1 same-RS P10 revalidation form. A valid failing stream becomes NOT_YET and requires targeted remediation followed by a new full PRIMARY→CONFIRMATION cycle for that stream. Technical invalidity does not count as failure and does not reset freshness until valid evidence is obtained.
minimum_evidence_rule: Frozen prose naturally contains ≥5 eligible events; exactly 5 are scored; all 5 assessable.

competency: Maintain a calm, reasonably even oral pace rather than rushing and stalling.

measurement: Compute WPM for four equal assessable-word quartiles. pace_spread = (max quartile WPM - min quartile WPM) / median quartile WPM.

measurement: Compare middle-third final_accuracy and WPM with first-third values; record middle-third multiword skips and unexplained silences.
p10_success_rule: At P10: middle-third accuracy is within 2 percentage points of first-third accuracy, no 2+ word skip, and no unexplained silence >6 s.
readiness_evidence_rule: Use same-RS valid P10 evidence under the canonical readiness specification.
readiness_status_rule: Use readiness_state only: PRIMARY_PENDING → PRIMARY_PASS/CONFIRMATION_PENDING → CONFIRMED_READY, or cause-specific NOT_YET / DISCORDANT_NOT_YET / REASSESS_TECHNICAL / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE / INVALID_FORM / DIAGNOSTIC_HOLD. Only CONFIRMED_READY initially closes readiness; BASELINE_MASTERY is progress reporting only.
p10_confirmation_policy: CONFIRM-1.0: A single valid P10 pass never closes an RS. Each RS readiness cycle uses two fresh unseen equivalent P10 forms: PRIMARY then CONFIRMATION. No coaching, hints, scored-result disclosure, or targeted practice may occur between a passing PRIMARY and its CONFIRMATION. Both valid forms must satisfy the same RS P10 readiness rule. If PRIMARY fails, stop the cycle and remediate before a new cycle. If PRIMARY passes but CONFIRMATION fails, mark DISCORDANT_NOT_YET and remediate before a new cycle. Technical-invalid forms are REASSESS_TECHNICAL and do not count as valid attempts. All valid forms remain in the audit record; the system may never cherry-pick the best historical pass.
equivalent_form_policy: EQUIV-2.1: exact 100 COUNT-100 words; World 1 one-word display; same RS/P10, scoring version, threshold version/status, comprehension blueprint class and safety/accessibility gates; fresh unseen content; non-compensatory global + RS-specific matching; candidate must pass all tolerances embedded in the canonical v0.22 Markdown specification.
attempt_policy: ATTEMPT-1.0: A readiness cycle is PRIMARY→CONFIRMATION. A valid failure ends that cycle. A new cycle may begin only after an intervening targeted learning block for that RS. After two consecutive failed/discordant valid cycles, set DIAGNOSTIC_HOLD and require at least two targeted non-readiness practice passages plus a documented diagnostic review before another readiness cycle. There is no unlimited back-to-back retry loop. Genuine later learning may reopen assessment after the required learning block.

Comprehension readiness requires two independent first-attempt passes on fresh matched forms: COMP_PRIMARY_PASS then COMP_CONFIRMATION_PASS. Both forms use the same P10 blueprint class but fresh passage evidence and fresh question wording. Only COMPREHENSION_CONFIRMED contributes to Band-A readiness.
readiness_recency_rule: Readiness evidence remains CURRENT until the first of: >56 calendar days since the latest passing same-RS confirmation/revalidation; >16 subsequent valid Band-A assessment/remediation sessions; or >28 consecutive calendar days with no SpeedReader learning session. Material scoring/threshold-version changes invalidate evidence immediately rather than merely making it stale. These numeric limits are PROVISIONAL_PILOT and require later calibration.
revalidation_rule: When evidence is REVALIDATION_DUE only because of recency/inactivity, use one fresh unseen EQUIV-2.1 same-RS P10 revalidation form. Score oral and comprehension streams independently before any targeted feedback. A passing stream renews only that stream's freshness anchor.
